spec.summary: 通用异构SoC概览，展示CPU和NPU的缓存一致性客户端、共享互联与LLC，以及存储控制器和主机入口。箭头只表示请求方向，不完整展开返回和snoop。

spec.layout: Keep one SoC boundary containing cpu,npu,shared,memory,hostio. Stack cpu and npu as parallel left-side peer groups, cores/private and tensor/nc internally ordered left to right. Place shared center, fabric then llc; memory right. dram is beyond SoC on right. hostio is lower-left and host outside left, feeding fabric. Direct unobstructed local links; group boundaries hug content. Preserve each actual node and exact request endpoint; do not fold connections into boundary-only arrows.
annotations: Request paths shown; response and snoop detail omitted.
checks: 确认CPU与NPU为平行客户端，片外设备在SoC外。
确认示意仅为请求方向，不宣称完整一致性协议。

description: Draw an English flat engineering system architecture figure titled 'Coherent Heterogeneous SoC'. This is a generic reference system, not a physical floorplan. Within one SoC boundary: a CPU Cluster contains CPU Cores and Private Cache; an NPU Cluster contains Tensor Engines and NPU Cache; Shared Resources contains Coherent Fabric and Shared LLC; Memory Interface contains DRAM Controller; Host I/O contains PCIe Endpoint. External DRAM and an External Host are outside the SoC boundary. Show only the high-level memory/request direction, not all response signals: CPU Cores → Private Cache → Coherent Fabric; Tensor Engines → NPU Cache → Coherent Fabric; Coherent Fabric → Shared LLC → DRAM Controller → External DRAM; External Host → PCIe Endpoint → Coherent Fabric. CPU and NPU caches are coherent clients; do not add bypasses, capacities, clocks, core counts, snoop routes or physical details. Draw all named modules and group ownership at a readable scale in a single figure. The reader should immediately see compute clients, shared coherence/cache, memory access, and host ingress. Generic conceptual architecture. English labels only.

settings.notes: Strictly flat, front-facing system illustration. White background, restrained blue compute clients and warm neutral memory. No perspective, shadows or materials. Keep the named ownership and selected request paths readable.
